QuestInfo.name: Alfonse Green's Herb 3
QuestInfo.0: #bAlfonse Green#k in #bOrbis Cloud Park 1#k needs something...
QuestInfo.1: Alfonse Green wants Peppermint Flower Oil for aroma therapy. You might need a special skill to create Peppermint Flower Oil.\n\n#i4023010##t4023010#  #b#c4023010# / 1#k
QuestInfo.2: You gave Peppermint Flower Oil to Alfonse Green.

0.0: Hello again, #h0#! Did you know that herbs aren't just for making tea, but also for making into an oil? It's great for your skin! I believe they call it Aroma Therapy. I'd like to give it a try.
0.1: But, as usual, it's quite hard to get the oil. You need to gather herbs, then extract the oil from them... I don't suppose you could help me?

yes.0: I'd like you to get some #bPeppermint Flower Oil#k. Even Herbalists might have trouble with this one, since Peppermint Flowers are only occasionally found in #bEmerald Herbs#k. But you're good at difficult tasks, so I have faith in you!

no.0: Perhaps I shall give up on this one. Oh well.

1.0: Oh, Peppermint Flower Oil! Thank you. I look forward to the various aromas and therapies I will enjoy!

yes.0: Thank you for everything! I know who to call if I need any more herbs.

item.0: Can't find any #bPeppermint Flower Oil#k? So it IS that rare... Hm. A skilled Herbalist might have some to spare.
